answer_1.quote: Keyphrase Generation (KPG) involves predicting both types of keyphrases... we focus on fine-tuning Transformer-based sequence-to-sequence PLMs BART and T5 for KPG with the "One2Seq" formulation.

answer_2.quote: We adopt lexical-based and semantic-based evaluation to evaluate a model's predictions... For lexical evaluation, we ... use the P@M, R@M, and F1@M scores. For semantic evaluation, we ... report SemP, SemR, and SemF1.
